description: Dirty-data scenarios. Each file replaces <source>.json on the same logical date as a clean run of data/samples/{orders,products}.json. Business-rule violations reject one record; schema/JSON problems quarantine the file and hold the release. loaded/rejected/parked_items/warns describe silver for that delivery only.

scenarios.name: orders_bad_quantity
scenarios.description: Item with quantity 0: that order is rejected, the other order in the file loads.

scenarios.name: orders_negative_price
scenarios.description: Item with a negative unit_price.

scenarios.name: orders_reused_item_id
scenarios.description: order_item_id reused by a later order, twice in one order, or owned by an order already in silver.

rejected.O4007: appears more than once in the order
rejected.O4008: already belongs to order O1001 in silver

scenarios.name: orders_future_dated
scenarios.description: ordered_at after the batch date.

scenarios.name: orders_duplicates
scenarios.description: O4011 sent twice with different content (both rejected); O4012 sent twice identically (kept once, WARN).

rejected.O4011: conflicting duplicates for order_id O4011 (2 versions)

scenarios.name: orders_unknown_product
scenarios.description: Order with one item whose product is not in the catalog: order kept, item parked, kept out of gold.
warns: item OI-4013-2 references unknown product P500 (parked)

scenarios.name: orders_customer_name_conflict
scenarios.description: Same customer_id with two names in one batch: WARN, last one kept.
warns: customer C005 has 2 names in batch

scenarios.name: orders_bad_schema
scenarios.description: quantity is a string: file-level schema violation.

scenarios.name: orders_wrong_source
scenarios.description: Envelope source is not order_service.

scenarios.name: orders_empty
scenarios.description: Valid envelope with zero records.

scenarios.name: orders_invalid_json
scenarios.description: Truncated file.

scenarios.name: orders_missing_customer
scenarios.description: One order has no customer object: required field missing, whole file quarantined.

scenarios.name: orders_bad_timestamp
scenarios.description: ordered_at is MM/DD/YYYY, not ISO-8601.

scenarios.name: orders_no_items
scenarios.description: An order with items: [] violates minItems 1.

scenarios.name: products_negative_price
scenarios.description: Negative price on an existing product (old version stays) and on a new one.

scenarios.name: products_no_current_price
scenarios.description: No current price: rejected. P404 only has a current price plus a history row: kept.

scenarios.name: products_two_current_prices
scenarios.description: Two current prices in one currency is ambiguous; one per currency is fine.

scenarios.name: products_duplicates
scenarios.description: P407 sent twice with different content (both rejected); P408 twice identically (kept once, WARN).

rejected.P407: conflicting duplicates for product_id P407 (2 versions)

scenarios.name: products_new_product
scenarios.description: Adds P500, the product orders_unknown_product refers to.

scenarios.name: products_volume_spike
scenarios.description: 3 -> 8 records (+167%) against the previous accepted file: WARN only, everything loads.

scenarios.name: products_batch_reuse
scenarios.description: Same batch_id as the accepted delivery (20260902_products) but P300 costs 26.00: WARN, new SCD-2 version.

scenarios.name: products_price_change
scenarios.description: P100 catalog price changes: new SCD-2 version.

scenarios.name: products_bad_currency
scenarios.description: Lowercase currency code violates the schema pattern.

scenarios.name: gold_reconciliation_tamper
scenarios.description: Gold revenue edited after the build: reconciliation check fails, release is HELD, destinations keep the previous release.
scenarios.talking_point: The reconciliation check re-derives expected gold totals from silver, so a bad gold build can never be promoted.

scenarios.name: release_retry_reuse
scenarios.description: create_release called twice for the same run and date returns the same BUILDING release.
scenarios.talking_point: Task retries are idempotent: a retried create_release reuses the BUILDING release instead of minting a new version.

scenarios.name: additive_schema_change
scenarios.description: Products file with an extra unknown field per record is ACCEPTED and loads.
scenarios.where: bronze.arrival (ACCEPTED), bronze.record payload keeps the extra field
scenarios.talking_point: Schemas require what silver needs and tolerate extra properties, so upstream can add fields without a quarantine.

scenarios.name: landing_file_missing
scenarios.description: No landing file: ingest raises FileNotFoundError and writes no bronze.arrival row.
scenarios.where: Airflow task log (failed ingest task), no new bronze.arrival row
scenarios.talking_point: A missing file is not a delivery: the task fails loudly and retries instead of recording a fake arrival.

scenarios.name: warehouse_down_mid_run
scenarios.description: Warehouse unreachable mid-run: the task retries (retries=2); the release stays BUILDING and is reused on retry.
scenarios.where: Airflow task retries; ops.release stays BUILDING until publish or hold
scenarios.talking_point: Every DB step is its own transaction and create_release reuses the BUILDING row, so a retry resumes rather than restarts.

scenarios.name: breaking_schema_change
scenarios.description: Incompatible upstream change (renamed or retyped field): files quarantine against v1 until a v2 schema is rolled out.
scenarios.where: bronze.arrival QUARANTINED with the JSON path; schemas/ folder
scenarios.talking_point: Breaking change means a new schemas/<source>.v2.json and a versioned rollout; v1 files keep validating against v1.

scenarios.name: orders_customer_change
scenarios.description: C001's name changes to Jordan Chen effective 2026-09-10.

scenarios.name: orders_customer_late_arrival
scenarios.description: A later delivery reports C001's corrected name effective 2026-09-05, before the known 2026-09-10 version.
